reviews.text: It works as it should, the color match was perfect. I recommend for everyone who wanna use it daily
reviews.zh: 用起上嚟正常運作，顏色配搭完美。想日日用嘅朋友我都推薦。

reviews.text: Great product. The tip is super fine but the pencil itself is not so fragile that it breaks. You can get delicate strokes and blend easily with the brush for a natural look!
reviews.zh: 產品好正。筆尖超幼，但支筆本身又唔會脆弱到斷。可以畫到好細緻嘅線，配合掃頭好易 blend，造出自然妝效！

reviews.text: Offers great precision with a natural look. Very blendable with the spoolie end. Can be prone to smudging so make sure to set with powder for longer-lasting results!
reviews.zh: 精準度高又有自然妝感。用掃頭嗰邊好易 blend。容易有少少暈染，所以記得用碎粉定妝，妝效會更持久！

reviews.text: I have black hair and light-medium skin, and the Grey Brown shade is a great neutral color. Great brow product that is comparable to Anastasia.
reviews.zh: 我黑色頭髮，膚色屬於偏淺至中等，Grey Brown 呢個色號係好正嘅中性色。眉部產品好好用，同 Anastasia 嗰啲有得比。

reviews.text: One of my most favorite eyebrow products! Smooth when apply with natural color. I usually use it to shape my brow followed by the powder product.
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意嘅眉部產品之一！上色順滑，顏色自然。我通常會先用佢塑形，再用眉粉產品。

reviews.text:
Love this 04 Grey Brown color for fair skin.
It stays put and the line is thin.
reviews.zh:
鍾意呢個 04 Grey Brown 顏色，啱白皙肌。
佢夠定，畫出嚟嘅線好幼。

reviews.text: Pretty good for natural looking filling but it's pretty light and you need to twist often even in one use.
reviews.zh: 自然填色效果幾好，不過顏色偏淺，就算用一次都要成日轉出嚟。

reviews.text:
描きやすいしやすいからリピ４本目なんだけど
パウダーしないと描けないの少しだるい
viseeの眉ペンシルも同じぐらいの価格だからそっちに戻ろうかな
reviews.zh:
因為好畫已經回購第4支
不過唔用粉嘅話就畫唔到，有少少煩
visee嘅眉筆價錢差唔多，可能返去用返佢

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
